major_increment_rules: move, remove or alias an existing offset
change an existing field range, polarity or meaning
change existing access, reset, WSTRB or side-effect semantics
change undefined-address behavior or the low-8-bit alias contract
reuse an assigned or reserved field incompatibly
minor_increment_rules: add a register only in allocated expansion space
define a formerly reserved field only when old software writes it as zero
add a capability bit and matching implementation without changing existing behavior
compatibility_rules.constant_naming_stability: Existing Python REG_*, C PROTECTION_REG_* and field-mask names remain exported; any rename keeps aliases through at least the next ABI major
compatibility_rules.deprecation_policy: Deprecate in one minor release, retain behavior and generated alias for the rest of the ABI major, and remove only with an ABI-major increment

generator_architecture.semantic_validation: Reject duplicate offsets/names, overlap, reset overflow, unsupported access, missing reserved coverage, illegal mixed semantics, incompatible ABI deltas and capability-without-implementation
generator_architecture.generated_headers: Record generated warning, generator semantic version, register spec schema version and full canonical spec SHA-256

derived_expectations: registered event capture and idle hold
generator_failures: selected field has no finite template
finite template references an unrelated field or source

drift_checks: spec changed but generated files stale
generated artifact missing generator and spec identity
behavior conformance artifact missing while constants are fresh
handwritten W1C priority differs from spec
handwritten W1P pulse width differs from spec
manual expected value not derived from spec

ast_fingerprint_policy.canonical_algorithm: Parse the unique top-level function, project each supported AST node through a repository-owned ordered semantic-field table that omits interpreter-added empty fields and all location attributes, encode the schema envelope as sorted compact UTF-8 JSON, then SHA-256 those bytes

decisions.rationale: A strict repository-owned JSON model minimizes offline dependencies and can drive every required derivative
JSON is already used for contracts in this repository, is deterministic after canonicalization and requires no YAML parser
Closed schema objects and explicit migration rules prevent silent model drift
RTL metadata, Python, C, Tcl/IP-XACT, docs, verification, compatibility, and an executable behavior oracle cover constants and semantics
Generated metadata removes duplicated constants without hiding policy side effects in an opaque generated bank
A finite vocabulary covers current and planned semantics while making the frozen unstrobed legacy behavior explicit
The delivered sample identity does not change on every public transition and cannot establish cross-word coherence
ABI 1.1 has no concrete software requirement that justifies a dedicated epoch or snapshot command bank
Concrete records allow the audit to derive missing, duplicate, unconsumed, and unconformed behavior coverage
Unused access classes remain documented but cannot appear in ABI 1.1 without a schema-versioned behavior and conformance mapping
The public production ABI is separated from reusable direct-input wrapper variants
A zero word proves no ABI version; additive explicit discovery begins at 1.1 and any existing semantic change requires a major increment
New software rejects bad metadata, preserves unknown legacy facts, and discovers Stage 2E only from its exact frozen capability signature
Only an explicit state decode distinguishes startup RESET_WAIT from ARMED without overloading recovery
This is the exact Stage 2G policy-state meaning
All three registered views have distinct diagnostic value and fit a capability-sized additive interface
Stable levels are safely pollable; pulse-only accepted/rejected events require retained state before exposure
The selected split block preserves 0x00..0x60 and leaves explicit growth space inside the 8-bit aperture
Named gaps prevent accidental allocation and preserve future expansion
Capability-gated additions preserve explicit version knowledge and unknown legacy states without inventing absence
The existing predicate can be true during initial RESET_WAIT and therefore cannot establish startup readiness
Repository-owned field projection removes interpreter-default empty-field drift and fails closed on new syntax
Each platform records one older supported interpreter and one 3.13+ interpreter without assuming a launcher name
Regeneration and independent extraction detect stale, hand-edited and contradictory outputs
All edits must enter through the source spec and reviewed generator
Only recognized magic and a supported major can enable explicit ABI features; arbitrary nonzero words fail closed
A zero version word does not prove one historical implementation, while exact Stage 2E evidence can be validated without inferring Stage 2G
Discovery must advertise software-consumable public ABI behavior, not internal datapaths
Generated constants alone cannot prevent handwritten semantic drift
Seven closed templates derive critical constants and expectations while existing directed tests retain readable project behavior coverage without a generic interpreter
Contradictions and undocumented frozen behaviors remain visible without a hard-coded expected count
Post-clear software can observe zero new bitmaps, a retained legacy fault code, and recovery pending simultaneously
Repository-owned extraction and explicit commands make portability evidence replayable without platform-specific launchers
The selected allocation, named fault-cause fields, complete register definitions, field bindings, and bit coverage form one machine-checked universe
A capability may advertise only after every public dependency required to use that feature validates
Known features remain safe across higher compatible minors without treating malformed explicit metadata as legacy
One closed structured grammar eliminates independently editable field and API capability expressions
The Stage 2G public-status equivalence bundle represents mutual requirements without a recursive directed graph
Register-level reset and static words are recomputed reports rather than separately editable source values
A closed expression model makes OBS_SEQUENCE_WIDTH evaluable and renderable across every planned consumer
The legacy fault code, simultaneous cause bitmap, aliases, generated names, and projection must converge from one machine taxonomy
Every dynamic selected field references a small checked binding table without duplicating paths, widths, or state encodings
Machine invariants preserve one-hot status, legal pending-state relationships, bitmap masks, and episode lifetime without claiming an atomic software snapshot
Fixed field and contract templates close required ABI behavior while rejecting a general clause DSL and complex interpreter
The Stage 2G pipeline clears its sequence output on idle, so the diagnostic last-retirement identity requires one explicit enable-and-hold register contract
The small Stage 2H source set is protected against module, port, width, connection, and state drift without a general Verilog semantic parser or declaration graph
Three explicit rules eliminate the ambiguous combined transition token and bind every update to valid and integrity-clean retirement sources
A four-member value preserves future advertised causes without inventing names or requiring a new software type system
Each added mechanism prevents a named Stage 2H ABI failure and is smaller than a general DSL, semantic parser, or RTL graph
Fault taxonomy content is folded into existing register-map outputs so no parallel seven-file subsystem can drift
Existing RTL include and C header paths and names remain stable while numeric values come only from generated register-map content
The audit closes only register-map and public-ABI architecture and records implementation and later convergence stages as not started
The future live source contains only public-ABI generation and validation inputs rather than audit history
